purpose: Q-03 deterministic static story-to-interaction coverage matrix

tier1.requirement: Primary and negative automated user scenarios.

tier2.requirement: At least one automated smoke interaction per interactive component group.

tier3.requirement: Render-only is acceptable when the component is demonstrably passive.
tier3.rule: No Tier 1/Tier 2 name match and no static interaction signal.

limitations: Static analysis proves the presence of play code, not that the scenario passes in a browser.
Source signals are evaluated at story-file scope and may apply to only some exports in that file.
Composed or inherited play functions can produce a low-severity source/index evidence mismatch.
